title: Minimum Swaps to Group All 1's Together
summary: For a binary array, determine the least swaps needed to cluster all 1's together anywhere in the sequence.
statement: For a binary array, determine the least swaps needed to cluster all 1's together anywhere in the sequence.
constraints: Any two positions may be swapped.
hints: The final block width must equal the total number of ones.
A window needs one swap for each zero inside it.
Find the maximum ones in any window of that fixed width.
Choosing the densest window minimizes width-inside swaps, and each outside one fills one inside zero.
editorial: Choosing the densest window minimizes width-inside swaps, and each outside one fills one inside zero.

tests.explanation: A length-three window contains two ones, requiring one swap.
A single one is already grouped.
